messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING — p99 latency breach detected for dedicated pool eu-west-1-prod-2. p99=2.8s (SLO=1.2s). alert_id=INC-20260315-001
maya: i'm on it. seeing spikes across streaming endpoints, a lot of stalled chunks and reconnects.
maya: quick snapshot: p95 ~ 800ms, p99 ~ 2.8s, streaming stall rate +12% (5m). queue_depth(eu-west-1-prod-2)=~6.3k
jon: pulling autoscaler + runtime logs now. any recent deploys to this pool?
ravi: no recent deploys. autoscaler shows repeated scale attempts that timed out. last scale_attempt_id=abc123 err='handshake timeout' at 03:14 UTC
sasha: referencing runbook: /runbook dedicated-capacity-saturation — will follow mitigation steps.
maya: customer-impact: partial streaming degradation for EU customers, some reconnects. CS has opened two P2 tickets. not full outage but bad UX.
jon: prometheus queries i'm running:

```
# queue depth
sum by(pool) (queue_depth{pool=\"eu-west-1-prod-2\"})
# warmup completion rate
rate(warmup_success_total{pool=\"eu-west-1-prod-2\"}[5m])
# streaming stalls
increase(streaming_stall_total{pool=\"eu-west-1-prod-2\"}[5m])
```

jon: results: queue_depth=6320, warmup_success_rate=0.42/s, autoscaler_retries=3 (5m)
ravi: hypothesis: pool saturated -> slow warmup (kernel/kernel-queue contention) -> autoscaler probes time out -> backoff -> queue amplification.
emily: i informed CS + customers A/B. letting them know we're paged and actively mitigating.
maya: immediate mitigations proposed: 1) reduce max batch size to cut per-token latency 2) divert portion of new traffic to eu-central fallback 3) manual scale-up of 2 hotshot instances for capacity headroom
sasha: lowering batch size to 8 on eu-west-1-prod-2 now (propagating).

```
# config change
PATCH /infra/pools/eu-west-1-prod-2
{"max_batch_size":8}
```

sasha: batch size change hit runtime at 03:26 UTC.
ravi: kicking off manual scale: `infra resv create --pool eu-west-1-prod-2 --count 2 --type=hotshot` -> ticket 2791. provisioning started.
jon: adding a temporary traffic diversion rule: route 25% new requests to eu-central-1 fallback to relieve hot pool.

```
# traffic route
route add --from eu-west-1-prod-2 --to eu-central-1 --fallback-percent=25
```

emily: CS update sent: "We're scaling capacity and reducing batch sizes to mitigate stalls. Minimal service interruption expected."
maya: monitoring p95/p99, stalls, and queue depth; will post updates every 5m.

(03:30) maya: p99 down to 1.9s, p95 650ms, stalls down to 6%
(03:34) ravi: hotshot instances are online; warmup_success_rate jumped to 1.8/s
(03:38) jon: autoscaler logs show earlier probe handshake timeouts correlated with control-plane network flaps; plan to raise probe timeout temporarily to avoid flapping.
sasha: applying temporary autoscaler probe_timeout bump.

```
PATCH /infra/autoscaler/config
{"probe_timeout_s":15}
```

(03:44) maya: p99=1.1s, p95=370ms, queue_depth ~900
emily: CS: customers A/B moved to P3, no reconnects observed now
maya: handing for night coverage to ravi (oncall night). notes: investigate control-plane network flaps, gather perf traces, revert probe_timeout after stable, runfull postmortem.
ravi: ack — taking over. will dig deeper and own the postmortem. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: incident INC-20260315-001 status -> MONITORING (Severity SEV3 -> STABLE)
maya: thanks team — great coordination. capture timeline & action items in postmortem.
